claim: If you use AWS Auto Scaling scaling plans only for predictive scaling, AWS strongly recommends setting predictive scaling policies directly on the Auto Scaling resources instead, because that option has more features.
question: What does AWS recommend instead of a scaling plan used only for predictive scaling?

values.display: directly on your Auto Scaling resources instead

qualifiers.condition: scaling plan used only for predictive scaling

evidence.quote: If you use scaling plans only for predictive scaling, we strongly recommend that you set predictive scaling policies directly on your Auto Scaling resources instead.
This option offers more features, such as using metrics aggregations to create new custom metrics or retain historical metric data across blue/green deployments.
